data.name: Mitsubishi windscreen replacement
data.description: Mobile Mitsubishi windscreen replacement across Sydney and NSW. We confirm the exact glass your Mitsubishi takes, arrange calibration where needed, and quote.

mainEntity.name: Can you replace a Mitsubishi windscreen at my home or work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and that is how we do most Mitsubishi jobs. We bring the glass, the urethane and the tools to the vehicle. We need room to open both front doors and somewhere reasonably sheltered if it is raining.

mainEntity.name: Does my Mitsubishi need the camera recalibrated after a new windscreen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Almost certainly, if it carries Forward Collision Mitigation. We confirm it from your build when you book and include it in the quote rather than adding it later. See windscreen replacement for how calibration fits into the job.

mainEntity.name: What decides the price of a Mitsubishi windscreen?

acceptedAnswer.text: On a Mitsubishi the single biggest step is whether Forward Collision Mitigation is fitted, because that adds a calibration to the job as well as narrowing the glass. The build year and grade decide the rest. Our cost guide explains each factor.

mainEntity.name: Can a chip in a Mitsubishi windscreen be repaired instead?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often, and on a Mitsubishi it is worth asking early: keeping the original glass means the camera behind it never moves, so there is no calibration to arrange either. See windscreen chip repair .
